study.question: Does replacing the auxiliary feedback readout by the uniform valid-history readout close the residual full-versus-counts membership gap when the primary scorer already uses row-local gates? This completes a pathway falsification control; it does not test a new source of information or claim an accuracy improvement.
study.hypothesis: The incumbent can use union membership through (i) cross-row primary scorer Dice normalization, including support-population gradients, and (ii) the detached auxiliary feedback history base, which changes auxiliary private learning and the inherited surrogate context transfer. Either route alone can remain after a single intervention. With row-local primary gates AND a uniform auxiliary base in train and eval, neither full nor counts-only membership has a prediction-relevant path at fixed weights or along training. The new pair should agree numerically. A persistent difference falsifies this pathway-accounting hypothesis or its implementation. The masks themselves are deterministic functions of supplied action codes, so any original utility is an inductive-bias effect conditional on actions, not extra information.

nearest_work.difference: Read archived primary text lines 260-335: target-conditioned unnormalized weighted pooling and minibatch Dice moments are inherited concepts. This is a joint pathway ablation of an existing adaptation, not a new pooling architecture or exact DIN reproduction.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 123-170 initializes separate task sequence hubs with action masks. Here keep the incumbent union-membership compression, add no hubs or broadcasts, and test whether existing membership paths can be jointly neutralized. Original INFNet paper text is unavailable through this registry; no original-paper equivalence or priority claim.
Pinned Dice source lines 25-34 confirms BN cross-row coupling. Reuse the already evaluated g1-r0082 parameter-free row-local replacement; tower Dice and the functional auxiliary scorer remain native.

Pinned lines 383-408 and 527-575 construct task masks by action-vocabulary lookup and valid-history masking. Host construction stays frozen. No action-stratified permutation is proposed: conditional on identical action codes it would leave these deterministic mask bits unchanged.

inherited_components: Strongest visible utility reference g3-r0065-fixed_angle_cycle_source_bit_negative, reproduced byte-identically by g1-r0082-membership_full_native_bridge
Exact g1-r0082 row-local scorer implementation, 50-row affine folding/70-row gate expansion and 30-row pruned evaluation
g1-r0082 full/counts representations, including union-mask block counts, zero empty rows and unchanged valid item/action alignment
All field embeddings, target-match and ordinal/quadratic summaries, four private towers, task residuals and context-history products
True-label joint BCE and inherited first-order context surrogate VJP; this is not the ordinary joint-BCE context gradient
Independent auxiliary BN buffers and functional scorer execute unchanged during training; they are unused by prediction in the selected primary-population configuration
study.proposed_difference: Starting from each g1-r0082 row-local source, add one architecture-only auxiliary_history_readout selector. Select aux_strata[:,0,:] for every auxiliary task, during both training and evaluation, instead of aux_strata[:,1,:]+aux_strata[:,2,:]. During training aux_strata already equals primary_strata.detach(), preserving item/scorer gradient ownership. Leave all compression, scoring, task prediction, losses, input filtering and context-transfer helpers intact. The full/counts pair differs only in CONFIG membership_use and its constructor default. Existing native-normalization/uniform-readout trials and row-local/feedback-readout trials provide the single-intervention controls. No improvement or novelty is claimed prospectively.
predictions: The proposed full and counts arms have the same learned parameter count (expected 32192421, of which 31793216 embedding and 399205 dense) and same learned module/state-key registration. No new parameters, buffers, randomness or scorer passes are introduced relative to row-local sources.

At matched initial weights and frozen BF16 settings, all four predictions, joint loss and prediction-relevant gradients should agree across full/counts joint-closure arms; the uniform row is identical and primary normalization is row-local. Validate before interpreting trajectory outcomes when a host tensor-check facility is available.

Prediction-relevant trained parameters and validation predictions should agree up to measured numerical differences, hence the full-minus-counts click-AUC gap should collapse from the g1-r0082 row-local feedback value 0.0000582135067290 to numerical parity. Unused auxiliary BN buffers can differ and must not be mistaken for an open prediction route.

The two single interventions alone left full-minus-counts gaps: native normalization with uniform auxiliary readout 0.0000134479024380 in g1-r0081, and row-local gates with feedback readout 0.0000582135067290 in g1-r0082. Joint closure, if observed, is conditional structural support; it does not show that either route improves the original utility reference.

Absolute AUC need not improve: row-local sources previously lost about 0.0012 click AUC. Retain the original native utility reference for model selection. Count training, scoring, inference, memory and all failures regardless of this diagnostic result.
falsifiers: Material full/counts prediction or prediction-relevant gradient differences at identical state under the joint intervention refute the asserted path closure; trace them before interpreting any full-data gap.

A reproducible non-numerical full/counts training or validation difference after initial-state parity indicates unaccounted state, gradient or numerical pathways. Do not label that useful event assignment without a discriminating follow-up.
Any change to valid-event coverage, padded-event visibility, action alignment, labels, auxiliary loss participation, host seed/recipe or learned capacity invalidates the intended contrast.
Equal AUC without prediction/gradient diagnostics alone is insufficient to establish exact closure, and a same-seed bridge cannot establish repeated mechanism support.

This negative control cannot establish original conditional utility even if it behaves as predicted. Independent-seed evidence, valid-history membership permutations and a clear cost comparison remain required before a stronger original-utility claim.
alternative_explanations: The original 0.0000604313908928 full/counts AUC difference may be one-seed optimization variation or numerical trajectory sensitivity, particularly with the inherited batch-global surrogate VJP.
Row-local normalization changes the primary model substantially; its interaction with auxiliary readout is conditional evidence and cannot decompose the original model additively.
The uniform auxiliary replacement changes private auxiliary predictions and the context-transfer cotangents while retaining all true-label supervision; it is not an auxiliary-gradient ablation.
Counts-only split sums are algebraically equal to uniform pooling but BF16 multiplication/reduction can differ. Do not assume bitwise parity of previous g1-r0081 counts trials.
Unused functional auxiliary BN buffers may differ by membership even when all used paths are closed. Running-buffer equality over the whole checkpoint is not the correct test.
Official-offline delayed feedback, whole-window vocabularies and publisher snapshots remain inherited benchmark limitations; no production point-in-time validity is established.

trajectories.observation: DIN click AUC 0.6555440824200336, entry utility AUC 0.6689612705559688. This entire improvement cannot be attributed to task masks.

AUC full 0.6689612705559688; blind 0.6684078914570761; counts 0.6689008391650760; valid-history permutation 0.6688852920320618. Counts recover most of the difference; one permutation is insufficient repeated support.

Balanced weighting gave full 0.6688607529327432 versus counts 0.6689491305064144, reversing the content contrast. This branch did not improve the incumbent and prevents a general membership-benefit claim.

Feedback-to-Dice backward gate gave full 0.6684786730023866 versus counts 0.6683928239901419, both below native utility. It retained forward normalization and auxiliary readout routes; it did not refute all membership paths.
Uniform auxiliary base gave full 0.6688899334122161 versus counts 0.6688764855097781, a gap 0.0000134479024380. Primary native normalization remained active.
Row-local primary gates gave full 0.6677536981852739 versus counts 0.6676954846785449, a gap 0.0000582135067290, both lower than native. Auxiliary feedback base remained active.

limitations: No new performance, tensor execution, masking/backward parity, bootstrap interval, seed variation or training-runtime claim is made in proposal phase.
The joint intervention is a negative control for path completeness and may reduce quality. The original native incumbent remains the best measured visible model.
Masks are deterministic transforms of action tokens; explicit mask membership can only change representation/optimization conditional on the existing input, not add information.
No held-out outcomes are accessed or included in open research evidence.
